album.title: LSD and the Search For God

wiki.summary: If you like your pop hooks slow-cooked in shoegaze-gravy, have we got the song for you. LSD and the Search for God are as enigmatic as their name, which gives “Starting Over” and their eponymous EP a mystique reserved for the rarest of grimoires. Best enjoyed with headphones securely fastened, “Starting Over” invites you to get lost—and found—inside yourself. Read more on Last.fm.
